description: This file defines an Axios client instance for interacting with a backend API in a React application. It sets the base URL, manages authentication tokens, and globally handles 401 Unauthorized responses.

methods.name: axios.create
methods.description: Creates a new Axios instance with specified configuration.

methods.name: api.interceptors.request.use
methods.description: Adds a request interceptor to attach authentication token to headers.

methods.name: api.interceptors.response.use
methods.description: Adds a response interceptor to handle 401 Unauthorized errors globally.
